description: This Java enum defines different interest recalculation compounding methods used in the loan product domain of Apache Fineract. It includes methods to convert integer values to enum constants and to check if fee or interest compounding is enabled based on the method selected.

classes.name: InterestRecalculationCompoundingMethod
classes.description: Enum representing interest recalculation and compounding methods with utility functions for mapping and checking method properties.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer value to its corresponding enum constant.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: isFeeCompoundingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if fee compounding is enabled based on the enum value.

methods.name: isCompoundingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if either interest or fee compounding is enabled.

methods.name: isInterestCompoundingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if interest compounding is enabled based on the enum value.
